Caveat: without M9 (or any pull-up), VOUT1 will likely float or sit near VSS depending on leakage, so you must provide a replacement load (e.g., resistor/current source) if you still need a usable output voltage.
impact_estimate: Low if output voltage is not required; moderate if VOUT1 is expected to be a valid amplified output
